topic: running the command the README gives
prompt_markdown: AXIS's draft says: "How to run it: python label.py". You always run it with `uv run label.py`.

options.text: Keep it as written; AXIS knows more about Python than you do, and a draft this confident is probably right about how it is run.
Run the command you actually use to be sure it works, then put that exact command in the README.
Delete the How to run it point, since AXIS and you disagree and a missing command is safer than a command that might be wrong.
Ask AXIS the same question again until two drafts give the same command, then keep the one they agree on without trying it.
